integrity: The root and Toeplitz projection proof is analytic; the packaged finite checks are supplementary. Self-review was conducted, and independent validation was not performed. The October 2026 primary paper and preceding studies are acknowledged.
scientific_limitations: This theorem constructs at least n-1 isolated points and optimizes the distance of this explicit branch to the essential spectrum; it does not classify all isolated eigenvalues, optimize over arbitrary analytic symbols, or establish algebraic simplicity. The complete 2021 predecessor was not available for primary full-text comparison.
title: A sharp essential-spectral gap for polynomial Toeplitz outlier polygons
